text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, Dec 2 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - One vessel awaiting cargo, 5 due by 10/12. Approx 1 days delay.
Dalrymple Bay - Two loading, 2 waiting, 13 due by 11/12. Approx 1-2 days delay.
Hay Point - One vessel loading, 2 waiting, 11 due by 16/12. Approx 1-2 days delay.
Gladstone - R.G. Tanna - Maintenance completed on shiploader in no. 2 berth, back in full working order. Two vessels loading, 2 waiting, 23 due by 20/1. Approx. 2-3 days delay.
Barney Point - 1 loading, 1 due 15/12, no delays.
Brisbane - One vessel loading, 1 due 28/12. No delays.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Coal miners expected to return to work 2300 2/12.
Newcastle - Kooragang - 2 vessels loading, 15 due by 14/12. No delays expected. Channel 2 vessels loading, 2 waiting, 20 due by 17/12. Approx. 2-3 days delay.
Port Kembla - Berth vacant, 1 vessel awaiting cargo, 17 due by 6/1. Approx 1-2 days delay.

IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - From 3/12 lump re-screening plant will shut down for 60 hrs for repairs. Any vessels at anchorage or arriving during this period will be delayed at anchorage.
Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - A Berth, 1 vessel berthed, 2 anchored 4 due by 12/12. B Berth, 1 vessel loading, 3 anchored 5 due by 11/12. 5 Others due by 11/12, no ETAS received.
Goldsworthy (Finucane Is) 1 Vessel loading, 1 anchored, 1 due by 5/12, 2 others due by 8/12, no ETAS received.
Dampier - Parker Point - Maintenance shutdown, expected to re-open by 7/12.
East Intercourse Island - 1 vessel loading, 1 anchored, 2 due by 5/12.
Dampier - 11 Vessels due by 14/12 of which 5 for East Intercourse Is, 6 for Parker Point.
